name: assessment-design
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：assessment-design。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Evidence-based assessment design with rubrics, feedback strategies, and formative checkpoints. Aligns each assessment to learning objectives using Bloom's taxonomy. Applies Nicol's 7 principles of good feedback practice. Reads from /learning-objectives manifest and extends it with assessment specs. (idstack)
